description: This file defines the ModelPermission class used for managing permissions associated with services in the OFBiz framework. It includes evaluation methods for different permission types, handling permission checks, and invoking permission-related services.

classes.name: ModelPermission
classes.description: Represents a permission model for services, providing methods to evaluate permissions and invoke permission-specific services.

methods.name: evalPermission
methods.description: Evaluates whether the current context has the necessary permission based on the permission type.

methods.name: evalSimplePermission
methods.description: Checks simple permission using the security object.

methods.name: evalEntityPermission
methods.description: Checks entity permission with specific action.

methods.name: evalPermissionService
methods.description: Evaluates permissions through a designated service, potentially invoking a separate permission-checking service.

methods.name: setPermissionServiceName
methods.description: Sets the name of the permission service to invoke.

methods.name: setPermissionMainAction
methods.description: Sets the main action associated with the permission.

methods.name: setPermissionResourceDesc
methods.description: Sets the resource description for permission.

methods.name: setPermissionRequireNewTransaction
methods.description: Specifies whether the permission service call should run in a new transaction.

methods.name: setPermissionReturnErrorOnFailure
methods.description: Sets whether to return an error if permission evaluation fails.

methods.name: setNameOrRole
methods.description: Sets the name or role identifier for permission.

methods.name: setAction
methods.description: Sets the action identifier for permission, applicable for entity permissions.

methods.name: getPermission
methods.description: Returns the constant representing simple permission type.

methods.name: getEntityPermission
methods.description: Returns the constant representing entity permission type.

methods.name: getPermissionService
methods.description: Returns the constant representing permission service type.
